verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a visible recording bot, which gives some in-meeting presence disclosure, and admin-set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded. Neither is explicitly described as a consent mechanism, and Fellow also offers botless desktop capture with no stated disclosure. Missing for 10: participant consent notifications (pre-meeting emails or chat messages), explicit in-meeting recording disclosure or consent prompts, documented admin enforcement of bot visibility or disclosure, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
Users choose when to record, pause, or resume capture when part of a conversation needs to stay off the record.
